pages.title: About the clinic
pages.content:
Soroe Clinic was founded in 2011 by Dr. Ilse Varga on Linden Row in Wrenfield: an orthodontic-only practice for teenagers and adults, with four treatment chairs, a records room and a conversation room.

Before you leave each visit, the next one is already planned and booked: what will be checked, which trays or adjustments come next, and how long it takes.

pages.title: Treatments
pages.content: Fixed braces for teenagers (18–24 months), clear aligners for adults (12–18 months), review visits every 6–8 weeks of 20 minutes each, and retainers afterwards with checks at 3, 6 and 12 months.

pages.title: How a course works
pages.content: Three visits come before the first tray: records, a plan conversation and the first fitting. After that, review visits of twenty minutes every six to eight weeks, each one ending with the next already booked.

pages.title: Review visits
pages.content: A review visit takes twenty minutes and comes every six to eight weeks. We check the fit, the movement against the plan, your gums and cleaning, and we give you the next set.

pages.title: First visit
pages.content: Your first visit is a free thirty-minute conversation with no X-ray and no decision on the day. A parent is always welcome to come along. Call +00 20 555 0190 or write to hello@soroeclinic.example.

pages.title: Fees
pages.content: Fixed braces for teenagers from €3,600, for adults (ceramic) from €4,400, clear aligners from €4,200, retainers and first-year checks €380. Review visits are always included in the course price, and every course can be paid in monthly instalments at no extra charge.

pages.title: Patient notes
pages.content: Three patients, in their own words: Lena, 15, with fixed ceramic braces for 22 months; Tomás, 34, with clear aligners for 14 months; and Mariam, 52, with clear aligners for 9 months after an old course had relapsed.

pages.title: Team
pages.content: Seven people work on every course: Dr. Ilse Varga and Dr. Kwame Mensah, Nadia Haddad, Mei Lin Zhou, Jonas Berg, Aiyana Brooks and Sofia Marchetti. Both orthodontists read every new plan on Tuesdays.

pages.title: Contact
pages.content: Soroe Clinic, 21 Linden Row, Wrenfield. Phone +00 20 555 0190, email hello@soroeclinic.example. Bus 6 from Wrenfield station, 7 minutes, stop “Linden Row”; bicycle racks at the door; step-free entrance.

pages.title: Letters from the chair
pages.content: Four letters a year, in March, June, September and December: Saturday dates, retainer and aligner care, and one note from the chair. Nothing else.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.content: Soroe Clinic keeps the details you send us for one purpose only: answering your question or planning your visit. We do not sell them and we do not pass them on. You can ask us at any time to show you what we hold or to delete it.

posts.title: Saturday review visits from January
posts.excerpt: From January, review visits can also be booked on Saturday mornings, from 09:00 to 13:00.
posts.content:
From January, review visits can also be booked on Saturday mornings between 09:00 and 13:00. Saturdays are for review visits only: first conversations and records appointments stay on weekdays.

Every review visit is still twenty minutes, and the next one is still booked before you leave. Ask Sofia at the desk or call +00 20 555 0190.

posts.title: Why we plan the next visit before you leave
posts.excerpt: Before you leave each visit, the next one is already planned and booked. Here is why we work that way.
posts.content:
Before you leave each visit, the next one is already planned and booked: what will be checked, which trays or adjustments come next, and how long it takes. We started doing this in 2011, and it is still the part of the day Dr. Varga would least like to give up.

It removes the small uncertainties that make a course feel long. You know the date, you know the length, and you know what we will look at. That is all the method is.

posts.title: The year after: living with retainers
posts.excerpt: What the first year of retainers looks like, and what the checks at 3, 6 and 12 months are for.
posts.content:
When a course ends, the retainers begin. For the first year we see you at 3, 6 and 12 months, for a short check of how the retainers fit and whether anything has moved.

Wear them as we show you, keep the case somewhere you will see it, and tell us if one cracks. A replacement after the first year is €140.
